doc_body:
## Summary
Signal Peak Logistics is an enterprise logistics customer renewing their hosted usage and expanding into Dedicated + Optimize to address peak-hour latency and throughput variability.

## Current State
- Customer since 2023; hosted plan ~ $18k/mo.
- Contract end: 2026-05-31.
- Primary pain: noisy-neighbor variability impacting SLOs during peak shipment windows.

## Target Outcomes
- Predictable latency during peaks (p50 < 120ms; improved p95 during peak simulations).
- Sustain ~200 req/s reranking batch jobs.
- Reduce normalized token cost by ~30% vs current hosted.

## Proposed Solution
- Dedicated dual-region reserved pool (us-west + eu-west) with private control plane.
- Optimize pilot (6 weeks) to validate batching/quantization recommendations on canary traffic.
- Phase 2: optional on-prem enclave at Frankfurt DC for PII redaction stage (EU compliance-focused).

## Risks / Blockers
- Budget approval timing (April committee meeting).
- VPC peering and firewall constraints.
- Final legal wording for EU data residency appendix (now narrowed; trending positive).

## Next Steps
- Confirm SOW v3 scope/pricing and get legal to finalize appendix language.
- Schedule Dedicated sizing review + pre-prod benchmark (week of 2026-03-24).
- Produce customer-facing cost model including burst scenarios and Optimize savings assumptions.

## Owner Notes
CSM success criteria: signed commitment for Dedicated + Optimize pilot with enablement plan for 4 ops teams and a clear measurement plan for cost/latency/quality.
